control.name: CONTROL — the template carries no settings: every fixture repository forks automatic maintenance again (the #1608 race)

mutations.name: the template is written but GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR is never pointed at it — git init/clone fall back to the default template
the template config is rendered empty — repositories get no settings
TemplateDir returns an empty directory — a fixture passing it explicitly gets no settings
Run never checks the temporary roots — a binary whose TMPDIR/GOTMPDIR sit inside a repository runs, and the planted set-url rewrites that repository's origin URL
GOTMPDIR (t.TempDir's root) is not checked — only os.TempDir() is
the probe keeps the caller's GIT_* variables — a GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES that an isolating child drops hides the enclosing repository
could-not-check rounds to clean — every git failure reads as 'outside every repository'
the clean match is unanchored — a git error that echoes a path containing 'not a git repository' reads as clean
